newsitem.title: USA: NY Fed's McDonough--core CPI need not fall to zero.
newsitem.headline: NY Fed's McDonough--core CPI need not fall to zero.

text.p: New York Federal Reserve President William McDonough said a monetary policy goal of price stability need not target a zero reading on core consumer price index inflation, since the index is widely believed to overstate price growth.
McDonough told a gathering of investors in New York that a core CPI rate above zero would be acceptable.

"In looking at monetary policy, certainly one would have to think that if there is an upward bias (in CPI) and if you want pure price stability, in my view, the number on it is not zero," McDonough said.
